classification.difficultyReason: Propagate equalities and supplements through multiple labelled sectors, including embedded polygons and circles.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of each unknown angle in the diagram. You do not need to show reasoning.

spec.description: Vertical transversal through two rising parallel lines, each with one upper-right parallel arrow. Upper intersection: 70 degrees lower-left. Lower intersection: a lower-left, b upper-right, c upper-left. Plain endpoints; no arcs or fills.
spec.mathematics: The marked oblique lines are parallel. a=70, b=70, c=110 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 70 degrees and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$a=70^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$b=70^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}c+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\c&=110^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal transversal through two steep parallel lines descending right. One upper-left arrow per parallel line. Left intersection: a upper-right, c lower-right. Right intersection: 120 degrees upper-right, b lower-left.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 120 degrees and unknown labels only.

answer.worked:
$a=120^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$b=120^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}c+120^\circ&=180^\circ\\c&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rising transversal crosses two descending parallel lines, marked by lower-right arrows. Lower intersection has a left, b above and 82 degrees below; upper intersection has d above and c below.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 82 degrees and unknown labels only.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}a+82^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=98^\circ\end{align*}$$
$b=82^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$c=82^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$d=82^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Vertical transversal crosses two horizontal parallel lines with matching left arrows. Open right-angle square at lower intersection upper-right. Upper intersection labels a upper-right, b lower-left, c lower-right.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels and given right-angle marker only.

answer.worked:
$a=90^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$b=90^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}c+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\c&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Gently rising transversal crosses two steep descending parallel lines with matching upper-left arrows. Left intersection: a top, b right, c bottom. Right intersection: 85 degrees left above transversal.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 85 degrees and unknown labels only.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines:
$$\begin{align*}a+85^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=95^\circ\end{align*}$$
$b=85^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$c=95^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Vertical transversal through two rising parallel lines with upper-right arrows. 119 degrees upper-left at upper intersection. a upper-right and b lower-right at lower intersection.
spec.mathematics: b=119 by alternate exterior angles; a+b=180.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 119 degrees and unknown labels only.

answer.worked:
The upper-left angle at the lower intersection is $119^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$b=119^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}a+119^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=61^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram with vertical sides bearing one upward arrow each and rising top/bottom sides bearing two upper-right arrows each. Upper-left interior angle 115 degrees; lower-left a.
spec.mathematics: a+115=180. The two parallel pairs retain distinct arrow counts.

spec.description: Trapezium with shorter horizontal top and longer bottom, each marked by one right arrow. Left side rises steeply right. Lower-left 80 degrees; upper-left a.
Upright triangle with horizontal base and a shorter internal horizontal segment. Matching right arrows on these segments. 62 degrees at left base; a above internal segment at its left endpoint.
spec.mathematics: Left base angle constructed as 62 degrees; internal segment endpoints share one interpolation fraction along the sides, ensuring parallelism. a=62 degrees. Internal vertex names are not printed.

spec.description: Circle with two vertical chords marked by upward arrows. Diagonal joins lower-left chord endpoint to upper-right chord endpoint. 42 degrees at lower-left between vertical chord and diagonal; a at upper-right between diagonal and downward chord.
spec.mathematics: All endpoints lie on the circle. Vertical chords are parallel. Chord endpoints at polar angles 138, 222, 42 and -42 degrees yield the stated 42-degree angle between diagonal and vertical.

spec.description: Rectangle-shaped quadrilateral with both diagonals. a above their intersection and 130 degrees below. No right-angle markers or parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Opposite diagonal sectors are equal. a=130 degrees; no rectangle theorem is needed.

spec.description: Circle with two gently rising parallel chords marked by single right arrows and two crossing diagonal chords. 57 degrees at upper-left between upper chord and descending diagonal. a at lower-right between lower chord directed left and diagonal directed upper-left.
spec.mathematics: All chord endpoints lie on the circle. Endpoint angle sums make the upper and lower chords parallel. The 114-degree intercepted arc gives the stated 57-degree angle; solving uses alternate angles, not a circle theorem.
spec.answerVisibility: Given 57 degrees and a only; retain circle and second diagonal.
